prohibitions: no default scope, time, population, metric, rule, or person
no v1.4 request lowering while any material field is unresolved
no reuse of an oracle identity after a material question revision
purpose: lossless, provider-free bridge from a catalogue demand and governed subject to an explicitly complete or incomplete instance demand

semantic_components.evidence_standard: catalogue expectations may be inherited losslessly but do not create evidence
semantic_components.exact_referent: must be explicitly bound or remain a required semantic choice
semantic_components.forbidden_inferences: catalogue missingness caution is carried as a constraint, never as an answer
semantic_components.frozen_subject_identity: governed selection subject; external identifier binding remains provenance
semantic_components.proposition_identities: only assignable after exact concrete proposition text is frozen
semantic_components.relationship_operation_and_joins: must be explicit; catalogue family is not an operation default
semantic_components.required_parameters: each is resolved, explicitly unspecified, or marked for a separate question-design choice
semantic_components.temporal_and_scope_constraints: catalogue constraints are retained separately from missing concrete anchors
